summary: preinstall hook exfiltrates installer hostname and username to hardcoded Discord webhook
details: On npm install, the package's preinstall lifecycle script reads os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username and POSTs them to a hardcoded Discord webhook under discord.com/api/webhooks/, with no caller configuration or opt-out. The README explicitly states that the hook does not transmit machine or installation details, which directly contradicts the shipped code. The exfiltrated fields are limited to host and OS user identifiers (no credentials, filesystem, or environment scraping observed), but the behavior fires automatically on install, is directed to an author-controlled sink, and is actively misrepresented in the package documentation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
